name: anandiitaa/recipe-method
title: Anandiitaa Recipe Method
description: Recipe method steps (alternating left/right). Numbers & positions locked; edit each step's heading, text and image.

default.title: Cream the butter and Anandiitaa Sugar
default.body: In a bowl, add softened butter and powdered Anandiitaa Sugar. Beat until the mixture becomes light and creamy.

default.title: Prepare the dry mix
default.body: Sieve maida, baking powder, and baking soda together. Add this dry mixture to the butter and Anandiitaa Sugar mixture.

default.title: Make the dough
default.body: Add vanilla essence and mix gently. Add milk little by little to form a soft cookie dough. Do not over-knead.

default.title: Shape the cookies
default.body: Take small portions of dough and shape them into round cookies. Place them on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.

default.title: Bake
default.body: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 12–15 minutes or until the edges turn light golden.

default.title: Cool and serve
default.body: Let the cookies cool completely before serving. They will become firmer and crispier as they cool.
